title: EnchantedHarnesses
description: Faster Happy Ghasts with speed customization & a custom enchantment for harnesses
body: # Enchanted Harnesses | Happy Ghast Enhancements - Customize Happy Ghast default idle speeds - Customize Happy Ghast default riding speeds - Fully customizable (and optional) enchantment that increases Happy Ghast speed ## About Enchanted Harnesses is an all-in-one package for Happy Ghasts. Beyond customizing default speeds, you can customize idle speeds to prevent Happy Ghasts from speeding off into the distance once dismounted. You can also enable/disable the custom enchantment, change its name, and set speeds for each level. ## Configuration Configuration is in the plugins folder at `Ghasts/config.yml`. Nearly every aspect is customizable, including speeds, the enchantment's name, cost & frequency. ## Getting the Enchantment The enchantment is available in enchantment tables and the creative inventory.\ Players with the permission `ghasts.enchant` can enchant items with `/ghasts enchant`. ## Demo
